name: Spinning Volumetric Display Control Pipeline
definition: A control pipeline that converts text-based volumetric patterns into polar coordinates, packs them into a serial data stream, and transmits them to an Arduino to drive a spinning 3D LED volumetric display.
summary: The Spinning Volumetric Display Control Pipeline converts text-based 3D patterns into polar coordinates and serial data for Arduino-driven LED displays, using pre-computed static encoding for low-bandwidth transmission.
